data.Q: Which group takes Paul during the night?
data.A: The soldiers take Paul during the night.
data.wrong_answer: The cavalry take Paul during the night.

data.Q: Who goes on with Paul the next day?
data.A: The cavalry go on with Paul the next day.
data.wrong_answer: The soldiers go on with Paul the next day.

data.Q: After the cavalry go on with Paul, what do the soldiers do?
data.A: The soldiers return to the barracks.
data.wrong_answer: The soldiers take Paul during the night.

data.Q: In Caesarea, who do the cavalry hand over to the governor?
data.A: The cavalry hand Paul over to the governor.

data.Q: When will the governor hear Paul’s case?
data.A: The governor will hear Paul’s case when Paul’s accusers arrive.
data.wrong_answer: The governor will hear it when the cavalry arrive in Caesarea.

data.Q: What does the governor order be done with Paul?
data.A: The governor orders Paul kept under guard in Herod’s palace.
data.wrong_answer: Paul is handed over to the governor.
